Podcast marketing

Your podcast has something to say. We focus on the marketing, social media and audience-growth questions that help you connect with the people it’s for.

02

There’s a whole world behind every podcast. Let’s explore the support your show needs, where you’re feeling stretched, and how OIKIA can fit into the picture.

A sounding board for your next move. Bring your podcast questions, ideas and challenges. We’ll explore them together, with knowledge of the African podcasting landscape.
